name: NGI541: Controlled Paired HTTP/3 Cryptographic Execution Benchmark Dataset (R6.5.4.5)
description: This dataset preserves the accepted R6.5.4.5 controlled paired local HTTP/3 experiment for NGI541. The experiment compares two server-side cryptographic execution paths under the same application protocol, workload objects, network path, and measurement rules. Baseline configuration.NGINX QUIC/HTTP/3 with the standard OpenSSL-based server-side cryptographic path. In the internal experiment labeling, this variant is named stock. Candidate configuration.The same NGINX QUIC/HTTP/3 server, configured so that the supported QUIC AES-GCM packet-protection operations and AES-based QUIC header-protection operations are executed through NGI541. In the internal experiment labeling, this variant is named ngi541-direct. TLS 1.3 handshake processing, certificate validation, and the surrounding QUIC/HTTP/3 protocol logic remain under NGINX/OpenSSL in both variants. The comparison is therefore scoped to a controlled substitution in the server-side cryptographic execution path rather than to a full protocol-stack replacement. The archived material contains the accepted publication bundle, frozen execution provenance, paired result summary, methods, per-condition measurements, integrity information, and supporting visualizations.
